aggregation: ratio of summed numerator and denominator
class_coverage_note: Before FY2001 SBA left NaicsCode blank on whole industries (hotels, restaurants and gas stations are close to zero in FY1991 to FY1997), so a class figure for the window "all" or for an approval year before 2001 undercounts. scripts/markets.py refuses one unless the marker sets allow_flag and the page says so. "all" (every loan) and the windows from FY2016 are unaffected.
classes_note: Classes are not mutually exclusive (a loan coded 721110 counts under every hotel class); never sum across classes. "all" is every loan.
label: Charge-off rate by amount, seasoned cohorts FY2011 to FY2020
